name: Panic!! Kerokero Kingdom
original_name: ぱにっく!! けろけろ王国
source:
A lot of frog have fallen from the sky! Extremely selfish protagonist intends to defeat them quickly and become famous. Suddenly first princess of the country shows up and persuades protagonist to fight for her cause.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
大量青蛙從天而降！極度自私的主角打算迅速消滅它們並一舉成名。突然，王國的第一公主出現了，說服主角為她的事業而戰。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]］
